answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks through TEE remote attestation. Each agent binds a non-exportable signing key inside a secure enclave and returns a challenge-signed hardware quote tied to a unique fused chip ID. Attackers must procure separate attested silicon per identity, whether on a rural knoll, a rooftop ledge, or racks lit by violet LEDs. However, physical fault injection or leaked vendor keys can enable mass forgery while excluding uncertified hardware.
